description:
How to use the Fiend Saws - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this video, I'm going to be showing you how to use the Fiend Saws and Phantom Blade Zero. This is a truly spectacular weapon. Probably one of the highest skill ceilings in the game in my estimation. If you can really master this weapon, I think you will absolutely dominate this game. But it can take a while to do because there are a lot of things involved that you have to keep your attention on, and that's kind of difficult to do sometimes with the high speed of the combat in this game.
